production.rationale: The method coordinates input checks, FFmpeg strategies, process execution, validation, publication, diagnostics, and cleanup. It is a real review hotspot, but the audit does not prove a behavioral defect.

The diagnostic is attached to one partial declaration of an internal settings persistence aggregate. Partial-class aggregation inflates the type metric, and no defect or smaller authoritative owner is established.
The transfer boundary coordinates protocol, transport, retry-result taxonomy, progress, and resume identity. Further separation requires a behavior-led design review.
The transfer boundary coordinates HTTP, filesystem, progress, resume, and typed failure behavior. Further separation requires a behavior-led design review.
Create is the deliberate runtime assembly boundary that wires the selected backend and its owned collaborators. The finding alone does not justify artificial wrappers.
